title: RBRA and EPA Reimbursement (Richardson Bay Regional Agency)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

I request the following records concerning the EPA San Francisco Bay Water Quality Improvement Fund assistance agreement awarded to the Richardson Bay Regional Agency, San Rafael, California, on or about May 5, 2023, in the approximate amount of $2,782,586 (eelgrass restoration, Richardson Bay):

The assistance agreement, approved work plan, budget narrative, and all amendments, including any task or cost category covering vessel removal, vessel buyback or “vessel assistance,” or floating-home removal.
All requests for reimbursement or payment (including ASAP drawdowns) submitted by the recipient, with supporting documentation, and EPA’s payment records showing the amount and date of each disbursement, from May 5, 2023 to the present.
All Federal Financial Reports (SF-425) and progress or performance reports submitted by the recipient.
All correspondence between EPA project officers or grants specialists and the recipient or its consultants (Coastal Policy Solutions) concerning the allowability of vessel removal, vessel buyback payments, or disposal costs under the agreement, or referring to a “floating home,” “buyback,” or vessel registration number CF 3944 TZ.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson
